entry.en: To enter Senegal, your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Para entrar a Senegal, tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de tu fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You need to show border officials evidence of return or onward travel and proof of accommodation, or you may be refused entry.
entry.es: Debes mostrar a los agentes fronterizos prueba de viaje de regreso o de continuación y de alojamiento, o podrían negarte la entrada.
entry.quote: You need to show border officials evidence of return or onward travel and proof of your arranged accommodation. If you do not have these, you may be refused entry.

entry.en: You must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate if arriving from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: You must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re arriving from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: There are strict rules on goods taken into or out of Senegal, and you must declare anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay reglas estrictas sobre los bienes que se llevan a Senegal o se sacan de él, y debes declarar lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Senegal (in French). You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Cases of robbery, burglary and assault have become more common in Dakar, and in some cases involve weapons.
safety.es: Los casos de robo, allanamiento y agresión se han vuelto más comunes en Dakar, y en algunos casos involucran armas.
safety.quote: Cases of robbery, burglary and assault have become more common in Dakar, and in some cases, involve the use of weapons.

safety.en: There is a risk of bogus taxi drivers overcharging you from the airport, so pre-arrange transport with your accommodation or an authorised operator.
safety.es: Existe el riesgo de falsos taxistas que cobran de más desde el aeropuerto, por lo que conviene reservar el transporte con tu alojamiento o un operador autorizado.
safety.quote: There is a risk of bogus taxi drivers pretending to know you and then overcharging you for the journey from the airport. Pre-arrange transport with your accommodation or an authorised operator.

safety.en: There are frequent political demonstrations in Dakar and other cities, and they can turn violent.
safety.es: Hay manifestaciones políticas frecuentes en Dakar y otras ciudades, y pueden volverse violentas.
safety.quote:
There are frequent demonstrations about political issues in Dakar and other cities.

Demonstrations can turn violent.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Senegal cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Senegal.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Senegal cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Senegal, and the law is enforced and has led to arrests.
safety.es: Los actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Senegal, y la ley se aplica y ha provocado arrestos.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Senegal. The law is enforced and has led to arrests.

safety.en: Casamance has suffered decades of low-intensity separatist violence, so be alert for clashes when travelling there.
safety.es: Casamance ha sufrido décadas de violencia separatista de baja intensidad, por lo que conviene estar alerta ante enfrentamientos al viajar allí.
safety.quote: Casamance, the spur of land south of The Gambia, has suffered from decades of low-intensity separatist violence, largely directed at Senegalese security forces. Be on alert for clashes if you are travelling in the region

health.en: Medical facilities in Dakar are reasonable but limited in the rest of Senegal.
health.es: Los servicios médicos en Dakar son razonables, pero limitados en el resto de Senegal.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Dakar are reasonable, but are limited in the rest of Senegal.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises avoiding tap water and all dishes prepared with it.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja evitar el agua del grifo y todos los platos preparados con ella.
health.quote: Avoid tap water and all dishes prepared with it.

health.en: FCDO lists dengue, Zika virus, yellow fever and diphtheria among the health risks in Senegal.
health.es: FCDO menciona el dengue, el virus del Zika, la fiebre amarilla y la difteria entre los riesgos de salud en Senegal.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in Senegal including:

- dengue

- Zika virus

- yellow fever

help.en: Emergency numbers in Senegal are 15 for ambulance, 18 for fire and 17 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Senegal son 15 (ambulancia), 18 (bomberos) y 17 (policía).

help.en: Call 123 for the military police, who may be more responsive in the countryside.
help.es: Llama al 123 para la policía militar, que puede responder mejor en el campo.
help.quote: Call 123 for the military police, who may be more responsive if you are in the countryside.

getting_in.en: Blaise Diagne International Airport in Dakar opened in late 2017.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Blaise Diagne de Dakar abrió a finales de 2017.
getting_in.quote: Blaise Diagne International Airport in Dakar opened in late 2017.

getting_in.en: The old Léopold Sédar Senghor airport still handles some international flights to nearby countries.
getting_in.es: El antiguo aeropuerto Léopold Sédar Senghor aún maneja algunos vuelos internacionales a países cercanos.
getting_in.quote: still handles some international flights to nearby countries.

getting_in.en: The railway between Dakar and Bamako, Mali, has fallen into disrepair and no longer operates.
getting_in.es: El ferrocarril entre Dakar y Bamako, Malí, está en mal estado y ya no funciona.
getting_in.quote: A railway between Dakar and Bamako, Mali has fallen into disrepair and no longer operates.

getting_around.en: The main way to travel around the country is by sept places, station wagons that pack in seven people.
getting_around.es: La principal forma de viajar por el país son los sept places, familiares en los que se apiñan siete personas.
getting_around.quote: The main method of travel around the country is by sept places (from the French for "seven seats," literally questionable station wagons in which they will pack seven people so that you are basically sitting on the next person's lap throughout the journey).

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage advises setting a price before agreeing to a driver.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage aconseja fijar el precio antes de aceptar a un conductor.
getting_around.quote: make sure to set a price before you agree to a driver.

getting_around.en: The price per seat from Dakar to Ziguinchor is given as CFA9,500.
getting_around.es: El precio por asiento de Dakar a Ziguinchor se indica en 9.500 CFA.
getting_around.quote: The price per seat from Dakar to Ziguinchor, for example, is CFA9,500.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says the Little ride hailing app works in Senegal.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que la aplicación de transporte Little funciona en Senegal.
getting_around.quote: Little ride hailing app works in Senegal.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says you will also need an international driving permit to drive in Senegal.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que también necesitarás un permiso internacional de conducir para manejar en Senegal.
getting_around.quote: You'll also need an IDP to drive in Senegal.

money.en: The currency of Senegal is the West African CFA franc (XOF).
money.es: La moneda de Senegal es el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the West African CFA franc, denoted CFA (ISO currency code: XOF).

money.en: The CFA franc is fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: El franco CFA está fijado en 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: Outside major cities, ATMs are non-existent and credit card transactions unheard of, per Wikivoyage.
money.es: Fuera de las grandes ciudades no hay cajeros y los pagos con tarjeta son desconocidos, según Wikivoyage.
money.quote: Outside major cities, ATMs are non-existent, and credit card transactions unheard of.

money.en: Wikivoyage advises breaking 5,000 and 10,000 CFA bills from ATMs into small bills (2,000 CFA or less) as soon as possible.
money.es: Wikivoyage aconseja cambiar los billetes de 5.000 y 10.000 CFA de los cajeros por billetes pequeños (2.000 CFA o menos) cuanto antes.
money.quote: it is best to break the 5,000 and 10,000 CFA bills that you likely will get from ATMS into small bills (2,000 CFA or less) as soon as possible.

money.en: Dakar has ATMs accepting foreign cards but few elsewhere, and withdrawal limits can be low and ATMs regularly run out of money.
money.es: Dakar tiene cajeros que aceptan tarjetas extranjeras pero hay pocos en otras zonas, los límites de retiro pueden ser bajos y los cajeros a menudo se quedan sin dinero.
money.quote: Dakar has ATMs that accept foreign bank cards, but there are few ATMs or bank facilities in the rest of the country. Withdrawal limits can be low, and ATMs regularly run out of money, including in Dakar.

money.en: Mobile payment apps such as Orange Money and Wave are widely used around the country.
money.es: Las aplicaciones de pago móvil como Orange Money y Wave se usan ampliamente en el país.
money.quote: Mobile payment applications, such as Orange Money and Wave, are also widely used around the country.

etiquette.en: Always greet people wherever you go, as not doing so is considered extremely rude.
etiquette.es: Saluda siempre a la gente allá donde vayas, ya que no hacerlo se considera extremadamente descortés.
etiquette.quote: always greet people wherever you go. Not doing so is considered extremely rude.

etiquette.en: Never use your left hand to shake hands or give something to someone, as it is considered disrespectful.
etiquette.es: Nunca uses la mano izquierda para saludar o dar algo a alguien, ya que se considera una falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: Never use your left hand to shake hands or give something to someone as this is considered disrespectful.

etiquette.en: Do not enter mosques and other religious places wearing shoes, as it is disrespectful.
etiquette.es: No entres con zapatos a mezquitas ni otros lugares religiosos, ya que es una falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: Do not enter mosques and other religious places wearing shoes. It is disrespectful.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says clothing shorter than knee length is inappropriate.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que la ropa más corta que la rodilla es inapropiada.
etiquette.quote: anything shorter than knee length is inappropriate.

etiquette.en: Never beckon a Senegalese person directly, as it is considered very rude.
etiquette.es: Nunca llames con un gesto directo a un senegalés, ya que se considera muy grosero.
etiquette.quote: Never beckon a Sengalese person directly, even if they have done something wrong in your opinion. The Senegalese are quite sensitive to being beckoned directly, and it is considered very rude.

etiquette.en: Dress and behave modestly in public, especially during Ramadan or when visiting religious areas.
etiquette.es: Viste y compórtate con modestia en público, sobre todo durante el Ramadán o al visitar zonas religiosas.
etiquette.quote: Dress and behave modestly in public, especially during the holy month of Ramadan or if you visit religious areas.

phrases.quote: Salamalekum (This is Arabic) / Response: Malekum Salaam.
